title: Internet Identity login tracking (frontend) and admin login list UI

requirements.summary: Add a frontend Internet Identity login tracker that records at most once per browser session per principal without touching immutable hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: A new non-immutable component/hook is added that observes the current Internet Identity principal (via existing hooks) and triggers a backend call to record the login when the principal becomes non-anonymous.
The tracker avoids spamming: for the same principal it records at most once per browser session (e.g., using sessionStorage) unless the user logs out and logs back in.
The tracker does not block navigation or disrupt existing pages if the tracking call fails (fail silently or show only a console warning).
No edits are made to any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.

file_operations.description: Create a non-immutable hook that uses existing hooks (useInternetIdentity + useActor) to detect when the user becomes authenticated (non-anonymous principal) and call actor.recordInternetIdentityLogin() once per browser session per principal (store a per-principal marker in sessionStorage; clear marker automatically when principal becomes anonymous). On failure, do not throw; only console.warn.
Create a small non-visual component that mounts globally and invokes useInternetIdentityLoginTracker(), returning null so it does not affect layout or navigation.
Wire the global InternetIdentityLoginTracker component into the existing app layout (RootLayout) so it runs across all routes without changing current page behavior.

requirements.summary: Extend the existing /users admin-only UI to show a table of recorded Internet Identity login principals and metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing protected admin area at /users continues to work as it currently does.
The /users admin page adds a new section (or a clear toggle) that shows the Internet Identity login list returned by the new backend query.
The Internet Identity login list displays at least: principal ID, firstSeen, lastSeen, and loginCount, with sensible formatting for timestamps.
If the viewer is not authorized, the page continues to show an access denied experience and does not reveal principal IDs.
All user-facing text for the new section is in English.

file_operations.description: Add a new React Query hook (e.g., useListInternetIdentityLogins) that calls actor.listInternetIdentityLogins() and returns the records. Ensure it is disabled until the actor is available and not fetching, uses retry: false (consistent with existing admin queries), and normalizes errors via normalizeBackendError.

Extend the existing /users admin page by adding a new section below the current accounts table that renders the Internet Identity login records table (principal, firstSeen, lastSeen, loginCount). Use shadcn-ui components (Card/Table/Alert/Button) for consistent styling and layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Format timestamps from bigint nanoseconds to readable local date/time (consistent with existing account.created formatting). If the query fails (including Unauthorized), show a non-revealing error state within the new section and keep the existing access-denied behavior for non-admin sessions unchanged.
